description: This Java source file defines a singleton class 'DittoDurationValueValidator' responsible for validating string representations of durations by parsing them into a 'DittoDuration' object. If parsing fails, it throws a 'DittoHeaderInvalidException'. It extends 'AbstractHeaderValueValidator' and is part of the 'org.eclipse.ditto.model.base.headers' package.

classes.name: DittoDurationValueValidator
classes.description: A singleton class that validates duration string values, parsing them into DittoDuration objects, and throws an exception if invalid.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the validator.

methods.name: validateValue
methods.description: Validates the provided CharSequence value by attempting to parse it as a DittoDuration and throws an exception if parsing fails.
